title: Pilots report UAPs emerging from the Dipper

tellings.quote: Even Navy pilot Ryan Graves, who's very humble in his claims, has said that pilots reported UAPs emerging from the Dipper and even dog fighting near it in orbit.

plain: Pilots are said to have reported UAPs, the official term for unexplained objects in the sky, coming out of "the Dipper" and even dogfighting near it in orbit. Michels says this on an episode about NASA, attributing it to a Navy pilot named Ryan Graves, whom he calls "very humble in his claims".
